plan: Given my value of $24, I aim to bid slightly above the midpoint of the possible range to maximize potential profit while minimizing the risk of overbidding. A bid around $25-$30 balances the chance of winning with the possibility of a lower third-highest bid, maximizing expected profit. This strategy assumes other bidders' values are independent and uniformly distributed.

Given my private value of $9, I aim to bid conservatively to maximize profit. Since bids are between $0 and $49, and I only pay the third-highest bid if I win, I'll bid slightly above my value to increase chances of winning without overpaying. I'll bid $10 to ensure potential profit if the third-highest bid is below my value. This approach balances risk and reward, considering there's only one round and no prior history to guide predictions on other bidders' behavior.

Given my value of $13, I should bid slightly below this value to maximize potential profit while minimizing the risk of overpaying.
